name: Fragments of the Orb of Orahil
summary: Menara’s acolytes offer you paths inside the tower above Ratchet. Afterwards, you bring an Infernal Orb to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

sections.title: A Choice Above Ratchet
sections.body: Inside the tower above Ratchet, Menara’s acolytes ask you to choose one of their paths. What lies along each path is not named here. The choice sets you on the way to an Infernal Orb, which Tabetha awaits in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: Who do I speak to in the tower?
faq.answer: You speak to Menara’s acolytes inside the tower above Ratchet.

faq.q: What do the acolytes ask me to do?
faq.answer: Menara’s acolytes ask you to choose one of their paths to follow.

faq.q: What should I bring to Tabetha?
faq.answer: Bring an Infernal Orb to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
